prompt: Write a method that converts a camelCase identifier to snake_case. Complete the camelToSnake method in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: The conversion is a single pass that reacts to each character: uppercase letters mark word boundaries, so they become an underscore plus their lowercase form, while everything else is copied through. The one wrinkle is position 0 -- a name like "Value" starts with a capital but must not start with an underscore, so the underscore is only added when i > 0. Character.isUpperCase and Character.toLowerCase do the character-level work.
hints: Loop over the characters and test each with Character.isUpperCase(c).
On an uppercase letter, append '_' and then Character.toLowerCase(c); otherwise append c as-is.
Guard the underscore with i > 0 so a name starting with a capital (like "Value") does not get a leading underscore.
